en.title: Major Transit Accessibility Funding Awarded Amid iOS 27 Accessibility Updates
en.summary: The All Stations Accessibility Program awarded $233 million in funding following a $686 million offer to improve transit station accessibility for people with disabilities. Also announced, Florida launched its silent 911 lifelines program for emergency communication access, while Apple rolled out iOS 27 accessibility features including a new Accessibility Reader for dense text summarization and translation. Advocates highlighted ongoing concerns about disability skepticism and the need for greater societal understanding.

zh-TW.title: 所有車站無障礙計畫頒發2.33億美元以提升
zh-TW.summary: 所有車站無障礙計畫在獲得6.86億美元報價後，頒發2.33億美元資金，旨在提升交通車站對殘障人士的無障礙程度。佛羅里達州同時推出靜默911生命線計畫，為殘障人士提供緊急通訊便利；蘋果則在iOS 27中推出無障礙閱讀器與其他功能改進。此外，雄崎電梯捐贈車輛協助長者無礙出行，凸显社會對無障礙服務的持續關注。
